tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Window content background. The matte base everything sits on.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Sidebar, titlebar and status strip — one step off the content, never a gradient.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, list panels, the menu-bar popover.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed rows, the off-state toggle track, secondary button fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels and rows (1px). Decorative only — never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Panel outlines and the layout grid lines, where a divider needs to read a little more.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, off toggles and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on bg-000, bg-100 and bg-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every bg-* surface and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, server cities, body copy under headings. 5.7:1 or better on every bg-* and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Mono labels, timestamps, units. Only on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200 (≥4.6:1); not on bg-300 or accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lavender. Primary button fill, on-state toggles, the selected tab, key words in a headline, links. Text in accent reads on every bg-*.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (8:1 dark, 6.2:1 light). Never plain white on the dark-theme accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row and active nav item background. Flat tint, no border glow.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Connected / protected state: the status dot, the word 'Protected', good latency. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the connected status badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Connecting, reconnecting, untrusted Wi-Fi, medium latency. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges (UNTRUSTED).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Not connected, errors, the Disconnect button text. Coral, not pure red. Always paired with a word; light value not on bg-300.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the disconnected badge and destructive hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the surface colour. Solid, never a blur or glow.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one status headline in the main window. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles, setting names, popover headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Blocks all traffic if the tunnel drops.
styles.usage: Default UI text — macOS system size.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Ensures all traffic goes through the tunnel
styles.usage: Help text under a setting, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and stat captions, UPPERCASE, in ink-faint.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: IP addresses, ports, protocols, the log. Anything a user might copy.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers in the stats strip: latency, speed, session time.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dot-to-word gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between stacked text lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, list row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter between panels, window content inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between major blocks of the main window.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top inset above the status headline.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, country codes, keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the menu-bar popover.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle tracks and knobs, status dots.

shadow.note: Flat system: surfaces are separated by tone and 1px lines, not shadows. The only shadow is the one macOS draws around windows and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Every in-window surface.

duration.note: Motion is short and plain: fades and slides, no pulses or glows.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, toggle knob.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panel and popover open, row selection.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Connection state change (headline and colour cross-fade).
